lead.headline: Rice is out again — and two overnight quarterback adds left Stroud covering Week 7
lead.deck: Brissett for Lawrence, then Stroud for Brissett, Worthy for Strange. Daniels's Saturday tag is the one thing left to watch.
lead.body: Start with the bad news. Rashee Rice missed every practice with his hamstring and knee and is out again; Andy Reid called it a week or two. Josh Jacobs is eligible only from Week 7. Overnight you added Jacoby Brissett for Trevor Lawrence, replaced him with C.J. Stroud eighteen minutes later, and swapped Brenton Strange for Xavier Worthy, who inherits Rice's targets in Kansas City. All free agents, no priority spent. Stroud fixes the Week 7 hole — Houston's bye is Week 8 — and is this week's cover if Washington tag Jayden Daniels on Saturday; Daniels practised fully Thursday and Friday. The lineup as set is the projection lineup, 127.6 against 85.9.

doFirst.headline: Nothing before Sunday unless Daniels is tagged
doFirst.deck: No starter carries a tag. If Saturday's report lists Daniels out or doubtful, Stroud before 07:30 Sunday.
doFirst.note: Do not reclaim Kamara, Lawrence or Strange — all on waivers, and priority never resets. The quarterback seat is closed until Week 7 projections.
doFirst.empty: Nothing left to decide before kickoff unless Washington tag Daniels on Saturday: the lineup is the projection lineup and every starter is cleared.
